name: Electro / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. One taut tendon crack and wet organic snap simultaneously with a very sharp high-voltage electrical whip snap, followed by three tiny fizzing sparks. Immediate violent detachment, not continuous buzzing.
